title: Balanced Bismut torsion-parallel manifold with constant holomorphic sectional curvature
summary: A long-lasting conjecture in non-Kähler geometry says that any compact Hermitian manifold with constant holomorphic sectional curvature must be either Kähler or Chern flat. The conjecture is known to be true in dimension 2 but remains open in dimensions 3 or higher, except in several special cases. In this article we consider compact Hermitian manifolds that are Bismut torsion-parallel (BTP for brevity), which means that the Bismut connection has parallel torsion.
